meaning:
κατα-σύρω
[in LXX: Jer.49:10 (חָשַׂף), Dan LXX, Dan.11:10, 26 (שָׁטַף) * ;]
1. to pull down.
2. to drag away: with accusative of person(s), Luk.12:58.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and…
